propositions: _apply_authorship silently returns when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, hiding unsigned writes
fsck authorship tally is store-wide uncounted and lacks per-env breakdown, making single-env 0%-signed status invisible behind other envs' healthy volume
AC2: fsck must emit counted UNSIGNED_ENV issue for any env that signs nothing or authors all events Unknown, gated to envs active after store adoption of signing
AC3: _apply_authorship must emit logger.warning when signing is SKIPPED (not FAILED) due to missing author_id or signing_key, naming event uuid and ticket, while remaining best-effort
Dormant envs that wrote only before signing adoption must not trigger UNSIGNED_ENV findings to avoid false positives
beb1 environment (0 signed, 8914 Unknown-authored events) would have been detected had AC2 and AC3 been in place
